sources.scope: Portable instructions executed by compatible agent with native C adaptation; no DisCo CLI/model run or managed import.

construction.method: User-approved native C adaptation and partial drafting; manual stable-ID subskill orchestration and integrated create/verify stages. Required-backend blocks disable automatic admission.

applicability.scope: Pinned DwarfStar source investigation and experiment planning; not arbitrary GGUF support or cross-backend qualification.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to the pinned native-source contract and relevant memory/state/qualification route; native verification needs a compatible build, matching hardware/weights and task-specific execution authority.
applicability.input_contract: Engine revision/patches, actual model artifact/representation, selected backend/build and topology, memory/storage budget, context/chunk/session count, image inputs, sampling/speculation policy, cache state and quality/service requirements.
applicability.produced_artifact: A bounded executing-tuple report with observed signal, source-backed mechanism, alternate explanation, proposed falsifier, actual check outcome and unresolved backend/model/service gap.
applicability.failure_modes: Inferring model support from flags, aliases, file mapping or quantization names can select the wrong graph; treating CPU bookkeeping or parser checks as native backend/service qualification can overstate the result.
applicability.refusal_point: Stop at unavailable hardware/weights, unsafe exposure or the authorized budget; retain memory-guard refusals rather than disabling the guard to claim fit.

limitations: Metal/CUDA/ROCm inference, actual model output, SSD runtime I/O, GPU recurrent rollback, physical distributed behavior, service quality/performance and skill efficacy remain unverified.
CPU build/help and selected bookkeeping tests do not clear BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND.
NO_LICENSE is the actual unauthenticated GitHub CLI resolver fallback, not a legal conclusion; pinned source MIT notice is retained.
Only selected source bodies were inspected; full kernels, conversion/imatrix tools and every workflow are not covered.
recommendations: Choose the memory, serving-state or qualification route by the observed symptom and identify the owner, validity key and release/rollback boundary.
Freeze comparison controls, test the smallest invariant first and retain fallback messages, cancellations, refusals and unavailable fixtures.
Base model support on the actual loaded artifact and graph; use native backend evidence for model, tensor-parallel or service conclusions.
